input.quote: THE LICENSED TECHNOLOGY IS PROVIDED ON AN "AS IS" BASIS WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY KIND AND LICENSOR HEREBY
input.rationale: Article VIX supplies the Licensed Technology "AS IS" and disclaims all warranties, express or implied, and expressly disclaims that nonconformity to Documentation will be corrected. No affirmative performance warranty exists anywhere: Article VII only requires commercially reasonable efforts to provide Error Corrections (p0093) and gives no conformance warranty, no warranty period and no repair, replacement or refund remedy. That is the walk-away position, so we target the fallback: 90-day software conformance to Documentation, 30-day services warranty, and repair/replacement or refund, with the express warranties carved out of the disclaimer (including the retained "nonconformity ... will be corrected" sentence) so they are not swallowed.

proposal.summary: Add express software/services warranty with repair, replacement or refund remedy and carve it out of the AS IS disclaimer.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Licensed Technology is currently supplied "AS IS" with every warranty disclaimed, which is our walk-away position, so we have added the fallback warranty (90 days software conformance to Documentation, 30 days services) with repair, replacement or refund, and carved those express warranties out of the disclaimer so they are not swallowed.
